questions.prompt: Which empire was ruled by the Habsburg family for most of its existence?
questions.fact: The family expanded largely by marriage rather than conquest, which is why a line about others waging war became their motto.

questions.prompt: Which type of animal is a Komodo dragon?
questions.fact: It is the largest lizard alive, and its bite delivers venom that stops a wound from clotting.

questions.prompt: Which sport features the positions setter and libero?
questions.fact: The libero wears a different coloured shirt and is barred from attacking, existing purely to improve defence.

questions.prompt: Which sitcom features the characters Michael Scott and Dwight Schrute?
questions.fact: It adapted a British series whose creators expected it to fail, since the original ran only twelve episodes by design.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.fact: It was built from nothing as a compromise, because Sydney and Melbourne could not agree which should take the role.

questions.prompt: Which novel opens on a farm called Green Gables?
questions.fact: It became so popular in Japan that the setting is a pilgrimage site for Japanese visitors to Prince Edward Island.

questions.prompt: Which programming language is named after a British comedy troupe?
questions.fact: Its official tutorials once used spam and eggs as example values, following the same joke.
